about_the_game:
Disclaimer: Purchase of this base game includes the first chapter. Further chapters are DLC.

Ice Cream You Scream is a First Person Horror Game That Features a Player investigating a Abandon Ice Cream Factory That They Use to work at in 1978 You must solve puzzles, survive real life haunting entities and secrets about the Ice Cream Factory’s twisted past

Story You Play as Steve a old worker at the coconut Ice Cream Factory who decides to investigate why the Factory Shut Down

Puzzles While you Explore the Factory Obstacles can get in your way can you solve them

The Lore Experience The Factory’s twisted past on what happened there Even Friend or foes will have there own lore to them

MONSTERS Throughout you may run into some foes that will stop you from exploring

ARE YOU READY MANY SECRETS WAIT INSIDE
